title: independent_expenditure
description: One expenditure for or against a candidate: an independent expenditure, a party's coordinated expenditure or a communication cost, told apart by `kind`. Only `kind = 'ie'` is independent expenditure. Most rows are from the FEC's file of committees' spending on and gifts to candidates (`pas2`); from 2010, an independent expenditure a spender has reported in a 24- or 48-hour report and no periodic report holds yet is from the FEC's 24/48-hour file (`source_file`). Never a contribution. Partitioned by cycle.

cycle.description: The two-year election cycle, named by its even year.

source.description: Where the row comes from. `fec` for every row of v1.

source_record_id.description: The row's id, unique within a source, as text: the FEC's `SUB_ID` for a `pas2` row, and `<file_num>:<tran_id>` (the filing and the spender's transaction id) for a 24/48-hour row. A 24/48-hour row leaves the table when a periodic report restates it, so its id is not stable from one snapshot to the next.

jurisdiction.description: The regulator whose rules and ids the row follows. `US` (the FEC) for every row of v1.

committee_id.description: The FEC id of the spender: a committee, or a person or group filing as one (a non-committee spender, told by `committee.type`).

candidate_id.description: The FEC id of the candidate the filing names, when they are a candidate of the cycle, else null. Where the FEC coded another candidate's id, a hand-curated list restores the filed one; a second id the same person holds for the race is replaced by the one holding their money; and spending naming a candidate whose committee was handed to another (Biden's 2024 campaign, Harris's from 2024-07-21), dated on or after the handoff, is the second candidate's.

race_id.description: That candidate's race, the `race` table's key; null when there is none.

support_oppose.description: `S` for spending in support of the candidate, `O` in opposition. Null on a 24/48-hour row whose filer gave neither: such a row is in its spender's total and no candidate's.

amount.description: The amount in dollars, as filed: whole dollars from `pas2`, with cents from the 24/48-hour file. A correction may be negative and nets out in any sum.

date.description: The date of the expenditure as filed; for a 24/48-hour row without one, the date it was disseminated. Null when the filer gave neither.

transaction_type.description: The FEC transaction type (`24E`, `24A`, `24C`, `24F`, `24N`). Null on a 24/48-hour row: that file has none.

kind.description: `ie` for an independent expenditure (24E, 24A, and every 24/48-hour row), `coordinated` for a party's coordinated expenditure (24C), `communication_cost` for a Form 7 filer's communication cost (24F, 24N).

source_file.description: The FEC file the row is from: `pas2`, a periodic report's line, or `ie_24_48`, a 24- or 48-hour report's estimate. Null in a cycle built before the column existed, whose rows are all `pas2`'s.

payee_name.description: Whom the spender paid, as filed.

purpose.description: What the spender paid for, as filed. Null on a `pas2` row, which has none.

dissemination_date.description: The date the communication was first publicly distributed, as filed on a 24/48-hour row. Null on a `pas2` row, which has none.
